comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight tail cap, pour out its battery, and set the flashlight down; the candidate locks an adjustment screw.
comparison.physical_skill: Threaded-cap loosening, container reorientation, and controlled battery discharge, not coupled screw/jam-nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Cap removed, battery emptied, flashlight safely set down; the body lacks a full numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Although a thread is manipulated, it tests disassembly and pouring rather than preserving a calibrated screw position while tightening another nut.
